svg.text: Is ar scáth a chéile a mhaireann na daoine
Sources: General Scheme, Irish Nationality and Citizenship (Amendment) Bill 2026, Head 9; s. 16A; IP Acts 2015 s. 60(6), 2026 s. 237(8)
Time spent on these permissions will not count
where the claim is afterwards refused
of a refused EU treaty rights claim
or abuse, or later found not entitled
These exclusions do not apply to applications made before commencement.
